Downtown Nampa.name: Downtown Nampa
Downtown Nampa.description: Downtown Nampa core along 1st/3rd Streets with the Civic Center, the Nampa Public Library, and the downtown business district retail spine.

Old Nampa.name: Old Nampa
Old Nampa.description: Historic residential neighborhood south of downtown with pre-war bungalow stock, the Old Nampa Neighborhood Association, and steady renovation permits.

College of Western Idaho.name: College of Western Idaho
College of Western Idaho.description: University District around the College of Western Idaho Nampa Campus with student-housing turnover, academic infrastructure, and the Nampa Workforce Center.

West Nampa.name: West Nampa
West Nampa.description: Flamingo Avenue and Midland Boulevard corridor with master-planned subdivisions, the West Nampa growth belt, and the Middleton Road edge.

Middleton Road Edge.name: Middleton Road Edge
Middleton Road Edge.description: Western approach corridor along Middleton Road with new subdivision build-out and the transition to agricultural land.

South Nampa.name: South Nampa
South Nampa.description: South Nampa corridor along 14th Avenue South and Franklin Boulevard with light industrial, utility infrastructure, and water line replacement projects.

North Nampa.name: North Nampa
North Nampa.description: North Nampa corridor north of Interstate 84 with the Urban Renewal District, Northside Boulevard, and the Garrity Boulevard industrial-commercial spine.

East Nampa.name: East Nampa
East Nampa.description: East Nampa Opportunity Zone corridor along the East Nampa commercial strip with the Nampa Municipal Airport edge and large-lot commercial development.
